title: Ledgato Action Contract
description: One consequential action AgentOS asks to perform. Submitted to POST /v1/enforcement/decide. A permit issued on ALLOW is bound to the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this object (sorted keys, no whitespace); changing any field after the decision invalidates the permit. Enforced by engine/ledgato/enforcement.py::ActionContract.from_dict.

work_id.description: AgentOS work item this action belongs to.

id.description: Governed agent. Must equal the authenticated Ledgato principal.

identity.description: IAM subject that identifies the agent. Recorded; grants nothing.

resource.description: The protected resource. A permit is only accepted by the resource with this id.

id.description: Must name the policy Ledgato applies to this agent, or the decision is DENY.

digest.description: Optional. If present and not equal to the applied policy's digest, the decision is DENY (stale policy).

evidence.description: Requester-supplied references recorded verbatim in the ledger. Evidence informs review; it never grants authority.
